title: Joomla Extension - solidres.com - Unauthenticated stored XSS through guest reservation details in Solidres extension…
description: An unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Solidres Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 3.4.1 and 4.0.0 through 4.6.0. The vulnerability arises because guest-supplied booking details, including email and phone number, are output inside mailto: and tel: links without proper escaping. This allows attackers to inject malicious HTML attributes and scripts. Users of the Custom Fields, Hub, or Experience add-ons must also update to fixed versions to mitigate this issue.
